description: PostgreSQL 16 Query-Plan & Performance Fixtures for Transactional Outbox Pattern (#425)

fixtures.name: outbox_active_batch_polling
fixtures.query: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, channel, payload, headers, trace_id, deduplication_key, attempts, max_attempts, backoff_ms FROM public.transactional_outbox WHERE ((status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= '2026-11-20 00:00:00+00') OR (status = 'leased' AND lease_expires_at < '2026-11-20 00:00:00+00') OR (status = 'failed' AND attempts < max_attempts AND next_attempt_at <= '2026-11-20 00:00:00+00')) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

fixtures.name: outbox_deduplication_lookup
fixtures.query: SELECT id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at FROM public.transactional_outbox WHERE deduplication_key = 'outbox:webhook:expense:100:created'

fixtures.name: outbox_trace_id_correlation
fixtures.query: SELECT id, aggregate_id, event_type, status, created_at FROM public.transactional_outbox WHERE trace_id = '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' ORDER BY created_at DESC

fixtures.name: outbox_aggregate_lookup
fixtures.query: SELECT id, event_type, status, created_at FROM public.transactional_outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'expense' AND aggregate_id = 'exp-999' ORDER BY created_at DESC
